existing.server: createStudentRunCompletionGuard revalidates private Explain evidence, validates output, emits evidence.checked/output.checked

existing.failure: REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_MISSING or SKILL_OUTPUT_INVALID; terminal failed, cancellation cancelled

currentLimitations: Definition artifacts schemaVersion1 pins one requiredEvidenceToolRef.
Trace strict allowlist excludes durable storage/activity/scope receipt metadata.
SQL mandates segmentRef, which is sentence provenance and cannot stand for Activity.
Existing coordinator and final text envelope are Explain-specific.
proposedGate: Validate run/skill/authority/current context and mandatory receipt at finalization.
Refuse completed for missing, stale, mismatched or unsuccessful durable evidence.
Validate server-derived safe Skill output and unchanged current-position unavailability.
Emit bounded exact-version private receipt references through existing trace, not model refs.
Persisted versioned completion policy validates required receipt set for same Run/Skill/call/context and freshness, then existing fenced CAS.

failurePolicy.missingCall: Reuse at most one corrective planning opportunity within existing budget in future coordinator; no execution this turn.
failurePolicy.requiredToolError: not_found_or_not_visible/stale/unavailable/READ_UNAVAILABLE => fail closed; no implicit retry or new-plan fallback after domain failure
failurePolicy.expiredAtFinal: Reject completed; do not reuse old cached evidence
failurePolicy.needUser: Only a future separately authorized Run after context correction; user claim never substitutes evidence
failurePolicy.states: Use failed/cancelled from existing state machine; do not invent persisted NEEDS_TOOL/BLOCKED states.

persistenceDecision.requiredBeforeProduction: Versioned extension of existing artifact/trace/transition contracts and corresponding SQL migration; no new evidence or progress tables.
persistenceDecision.currentDBInspection: NOT PERFORMED; audited checked-in migration source, not fresh installed function definitions
persistenceDecision.preserve: Explain v1 policy meaning and historical run artifacts unchanged; no fake segmentRef; no migration installation implied by C2 package.
